items.name: multi_agent_architecture_review
items.acceptance: Reviewed current Unity client architecture and identified live scene, snapshot presenter, and build-readiness gaps.

items.name: multi_agent_build_pipeline_review
items.acceptance: Reviewed WSL/Windows/Android/iOS build constraints and recommended Android-first validation path.

items.name: multi_agent_gameplay_ux_review
items.acceptance: Defined P0 playable target as AI Encounter full match on device with command coverage and fallback legal command drawer.

items.name: write_unity_playable_build_plan
items.acceptance: TASK.md, PLAN.md, PROGRESS.md, and CHECKLIST.json exist under deliverables/azeroth-arena-unity-playable-build.

items.name: phase_0_build_hygiene
items.acceptance: Unity project has BuildSettings/PlayerSettings/build scripts/server URL config and can compile in Unity Editor.

items.name: phase_1_live_match_shell
items.acceptance: Unity build/editor can connect to TS server, create AI Encounter, and receive/display PlayerView status.

items.name: phase_2_snapshot_renderers
items.acceptance: PlayerView renders heroes, zones, hand, opponent hand count, status, and AI intent without mock data.

items.name: phase_3_playable_input
items.acceptance: All core legal commands are submit-able through Unity UI, with Legal Commands Drawer fallback.

items.name: phase_4_visual_commands_p0
items.acceptance: Core server events produce readable animations/feedback and reconcile to snapshot.

items.name: phase_5_device_polish
items.acceptance: 10-minute device playtest passes without crash, soft lock, or unusable touch/network UX.
